remarks: Stunning new home by Mattera Construction, one of Westport’s preeminent builders, situated on a bucolic 1.12 acre cul-de-sac lot in a highly sought after Long Lot's neighborhood. The 9,000 +/- sqft 6 bed, 6 full 2 half bath home will be finished on four levels offering an open floor plan, dramatic entry, gracious living spaces, sophisticated design, and finely detailed architectural elements ideal for today’s lifestyle. Conveniently located just minutes from schools, shopping, commuting, and the beach with room for a pool and slated to be completed Fall 2023. Pictures are representative of builder’s work.
